answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network mandates cryptographic stake burning where minting identities requires incinerating base tokens like copper reserves. Validation rights scale with non-linear penalties: registration fees grow quadratically, $C(n) \propto n^2$, imposing superlinear economic friction. An attacker aiming to flood an ocean of fake nodes finds marginal costs soaring over each tier, turning a small knoll of identities into an exponential financial sinkhole.
